planets.name: TOI-1410 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1410 with a 1.22-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-1410 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1410. Its orbit and size follow MacDougall et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
